title: covenant-report/v1
description: One run's verdict, as `covenant check`, `gate` and `diff` write it with --report-json, and the Python face's Report.write_report. Within revision 1 fields, kinds and planes are only ever added, never renamed or removed: read it ignoring fields you do not know, and skip a kind you do not know. Samples never carry a value. See docs/REPORT.md.

kind.description: What ran: check (data checked against a contract, by the command or the Python face), gate (a stream held to a contract record by record) or diff (two versions of a contract compared).

verdict.description: pass (exit 0) or fail (exit 1). check and gate: fail is over the budget, and warn is over it under `on_violation: warn`, reported but not failed (exit 0). diff: fail is a change at or above --fail-on.

plane.description: What produced the document: a command (ci when a CI provider was detected, cli otherwise), the stream gate (gate) or the Python face (python). The gate and the Python face keep their plane in CI, with the CI run in `ci`.

budget.description: check and gate: the run's violation budget.

violations.description: check and gate: violations across every source of the run.

sample_mode.description: check and gate. masked: each sample's field, rule and row, and the value's type and length. hashed: masked, and a keyed hash of each value. none: no samples.

sample_key.description: hashed only: the id of the key the hashes were made with. Compare hashes only between documents with the same sample_key.

checks.description: check and gate: one entry per source; a gate has one, its stream.

ref.description: The full ref: refs/heads/…, refs/tags/… or refs/pull/….

check.description: One source's verdict: a file of a check, or a gate's stream.

source.description: The source as the run named it. A gate's stream is stdin, or kafka://<first bootstrap server>/<topic> for the Kafka gate.

as_consumer.description: Set when only this consumer's declared fields were checked, with strict mode off: a scoped verdict, not a full one.

per_rule.description: Exact counts per field and rule.

unenforced.description: Contract rules the run skipped (--allow-unenforced): the verdict covers the rest.

sample.description: Where one sampled violation was, and what its value was without the value. Never the value, nor a message that would quote it.

row.description: 0-based record index; absent for schema-level findings. A gate's row is its dead letter's.

type.description: The value's type as its source held it; absent when the finding has no value (a missing field or column, a line that is not JSON).

length.description: Characters of a string, items of an array, keys of an object.

hash.description: hashed only: the first 16 bytes of the HMAC-SHA256 of the value's digest under the document's key, in hex. The same value has the same hash under one key.

rule.description: The rule's stable name. New rules arrive in minor releases, so read an unknown name as a violation of a rule you do not know.

gate.description: gate: what became of the stream's records. passed and blocked add up to the rows read.

passed.description: Records that went on, including those passed under `on_violation: warn`.

warned.description: Records that broke the contract and went on under `on_violation: warn`.

tombstones.description: The Kafka gate only: records with no value, which go on unjudged and are not among the rows.

diff.description: diff: a contract change, classified. Contracts are metadata, so nothing here is masked.

fail_on.description: The threshold the verdict was decided by (--fail-on).

max_severity.description: The worst change's severity; absent when nothing changed.

path.description: Where in the contract, e.g. models.orders.fields.amount.

consumer_impact.description: Who the changes break, when consumer manifests were given (--consumers).

manifests.description: Manifests read, whether or not they consume this contract.

impacted.description: Consumers a change hits, worst severity first.

unenforced.description: Rules on either side that were not compared (--allow-unenforced): the diff covers the rest.
